components.name: Self-Service Portal Frontend
components.purpose: Hosts the policyholder web application for policy viewing, updates, and first notice of loss.
components.rationale: Amplify Hosting provides managed global distribution and seamless front-end deployment capabilities.
trade_offs: Managed web hosting restricts deep custom server configurations.
components.security_considerations: Enforces TLS 1.3 and integrates with web application firewall protection.

components.name: Policy Core Microservices
components.purpose: Executes business logic for policy lifecycle operations, premium calculation, and product configuration.
components.rationale: Elastic Kubernetes Service offers container orchestration supporting microservices with zero-downtime deployment features.
trade_offs: Requires operational expertise to manage Kubernetes cluster lifecycle.
components.security_considerations: Uses IAM roles for service accounts and private cluster endpoint isolation.

components.name: API Management & Broker Gateway
components.purpose: Exposes REST and legacy SOAP interfaces while managing throttling and request transformation.
components.rationale: Amazon API Gateway provides managed API endpoints with built-in rate limiting and security controls.
trade_offs: Payload size limits require careful handling of large document requests.
components.security_considerations: Validates incoming tokens and enforces mutual TLS for external broker calls.

components.name: Relational Operational Database
components.purpose: Stores structured policy, customer, and transactional data in a multi-AZ relational database.
components.rationale: Aurora PostgreSQL delivers high throughput, sub-400ms query latency, and automated multi-region replication.
trade_offs: Database migration from PL/SQL to pgSQL requires automated conversion and testing.
components.security_considerations: Data is encrypted at rest using KMS and isolated within private VPC subnets.

components.name: Policyholder Identity Provider
components.purpose: Manages policyholder authentication, user directories, and multi-factor authentication flows.
components.rationale: Cognito offers scale to manage user growth while adhering to OAuth 2.0 standards.
trade_offs: Custom authentication UI customization requires developer maintenance.
components.security_considerations: Protects user credentials using strong hashing and adaptive authentication rules.

components.name: Enterprise Service Bus
components.purpose: Routes asynchronous events between policy services, claims processing, and integration adapters.
components.rationale: EventBridge provides serverless event routing with schema registry and filtering capabilities.
trade_offs: Requires dead-letter queue configuration to manage unroutable events.
components.security_considerations: Applies fine-grained IAM policies for event publishing and subscription permissions.

components.name: Batch Process Orchestration Engine
components.purpose: Orchestrates overnight batch workflows for SAP postings and data warehouse extraction within 90 minutes.
components.rationale: Step Functions coordinates serverless batch tasks with state monitoring and built-in retries.
trade_offs: Complex state transition definitions increase visual workflow maintenance.
components.security_considerations: Executes under restricted IAM roles with audit logging of step executions.

components.name: Document Asset Repository
components.purpose: Stores generated policy documents, schedules, and archival artifacts with object lock policies.
components.rationale: Amazon S3 provides durable object storage with lifecycle management and object immutability.
trade_offs: Cross-region replication incurs additional egress data transfer costs.
components.security_considerations: Enforces server-side encryption and S3 Object Lock for 10-year audit compliance.

components.name: Central Observability Platform
components.purpose: Collects system metrics, logs, and alarms across all infrastructure and application components.
components.rationale: CloudWatch provides unified logging and monitoring tightly integrated with AWS services.
trade_offs: High log ingest volume can increase monthly monitoring expenses.
components.security_considerations: Log streams are encrypted at rest and access is governed by IAM.

components.name: Application Insights Engine
components.purpose: Traces distributed user requests across microservices to identify performance bottlenecks.
components.rationale: AWS X-Ray provides end-to-end request tracing necessary to maintain sub-400ms latency targets.
trade_offs: Sampling rate tuning is necessary to balance cost and detail.
components.security_considerations: Trace data excludes sensitive personally identifiable information by filter masks.

components.name: Global Edge Security & WAF
components.purpose: Filters malicious web traffic, SQL injection, and rate-limits requests at the application edge.
components.rationale: AWS WAF inspects HTTP/HTTPS requests prior to reaching internal API endpoints.
trade_offs: Rules require periodic review to avoid false positive blocks.
components.security_considerations: Protects application endpoints from OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities.

components.name: Enterprise Key Vault
components.purpose: Manages and rotates customer-managed cryptographic keys for database and storage encryption.
components.rationale: AWS KMS offers hardware security module protection and seamless service integration.
trade_offs: Key management operations impose request rate quota limits.
components.security_considerations: Key policy permissions strictly isolate access per environment and role.

components.name: Enterprise CI/CD Pipeline
components.purpose: Automates continuous integration and blue/green deployments to enable zero-downtime releases.
components.rationale: CodePipeline coordinates automated testing, build, and deployment stages across environments.
trade_offs: Strict release gates can slow urgent hotfix deployments during freeze windows.
components.security_considerations: Pipeline execution requires approval gates and uses encrypted artifact stores.

components.name: Infrastructure as Code Engine
components.purpose: Provisions declarative infrastructure stacks consistently across dev, test, and production environments.
components.rationale: CloudFormation ensures repeatable environment creation aligned with compliance standards.
trade_offs: Stack drift detection must be monitored continuously.
components.security_considerations: Templates undergo static security scanning prior to stack execution.

environments.dev: Isolated environment for feature development and initial integration using reduced-scale resources.
environments.test: Staging environment mirroring production configurations for integration, performance, and regression testing.
environments.prod: Multi-AZ highly available production environment deployed across target EU regions.

deployment_runtime.text: The platform utilizes Amazon EKS for containerized microservices and AWS CodePipeline to deliver automated blue/green zero-downtime deployments. Deployment pipelines strictly adhere to annual freeze windows and automated testing controls.

availability_scalability.text: High availability is maintained using multi-AZ Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and EKS auto-scaling across target regions. The architecture guarantees 99.9% daytime uptime and supports sub-400ms latency limits.

backup_dr.text: Automated backups and cross-region replication provide an RPO of 15 minutes and RTO of 4 hours for policy data. AWS Backup and Aurora cross-region read replicas ensure continuous disaster recovery readiness.

observability.text: Amazon CloudWatch and AWS X-Ray deliver unified log aggregation, operational metrics, and end-to-end distributed transaction tracing. Immutable log retention satisfies 10-year regulatory compliance standards.

security_controls.text: Security controls include AWS WAF for perimeter protection, AWS KMS for encryption at rest, and Amazon Cognito for access management. Personal data is strictly confined within EU/EEA boundaries to meet GDPR and DORA compliance.
